items.title: The Ultimate Guide To Learning Japanese Mahjong With Friends (Riichi)
items.description: Riichi Mahjong can be daunting to learn and teach to your group, but I think a ton more people should be playing it. Hope this video provides an approachable way to have fun right away and work up to playing with all the rules Cheat Sheets: https://zes.sx/riichi/ Companion Document: https://bit.ly/4c7vkb2 I wrote up some notes/reminders for each section of the video you can print out so you don't have to scrub through a video mid game YMI Japanese/Riichi Set: https://amzn.to/4gkrcpe YMI Numbered Chinese Set: https://amzn.to/4qz94N2 Junk Mat: https://amzn.to/4hLBBge Compass: https://amzn.to/45FWNwZ Scoring Sticks: https://amzn.to/4xYKfwv The links above are Amazon affiliate links and I may earn a small commission if you make a purchase, Thanks for supporting if you do! AMOS Riichi Sets: https://www.mjstars.net/product-page/amos-smart or search "amos mahjong set" on amazon.co.jp Riichi Book I: https://dainachiba.github.io/RiichiBooks/ Some Left Out Rules Swap Calling: https://ooyamaneko.net/download/mahjong/riichi/EMA_Riichi_Rules_2025_en.pdf#page=11 Other Furiten Causes: https://ooyamaneko.net/download/mahjong/riichi/EMA_Riichi_Rules_2025_en.pdf#page=13 Continuance (Honba) Counters: https://ooyamaneko.net/download/mahjong/riichi/EMA_Riichi_Rules_2025_en.pdf#page=17 Riichi Edge Cases:https://ooyamaneko.net/download/mahjong/riichi/EMA_Riichi_Rules_2025_en.pdf#page=14 00:00 Intro 00:30 Why You Should Play 01:26 The Tiles 03:34 The Goal 04:12 How to Setup 06:32 Quick Setup 07:15 LEVEL 1: Riichi! 12:40 LEVEL 2: Using Opponents' Tiles 20:01 Choosing a Mahjong Set 22:16 LEVEL 3: Defense 26:40 Beginner Strategy 29:40 LEVEL 4: Keeping Score 30:06 How to Play a Full Game 31:47 How to Score A Winning Hand 34:46 Other Opportunities for Points 39:49 How to Play With Less People

items.title: Trying Gunpla For The First Time
items.description: This was surprisingly satisfying and relaxing to work on, I definitely see myself picking up another one Tools I Used: - Nippers https://amzn.to/3Vqc2F1 - Glass Files https://amzn.to/3VsKgrw - Gundam Markers https://amzn.to/4px0KwA - Hobby Knife https://amzn.to/4mqG72n Buying a Gundam Kit: Support your local Hobby / Game Store if you can! If not, they do sell some on amazon : https://amzn.to/4naUzN0 and here's a list of retailers by Country: https://www.reddit.com/r/Gunpla/wiki/shopping/ Check Out these other Gunpla Creators I referenced at the end of the video: @MadworksEssentials @NoneChannel- @spike_studio @EAGunpla The above amazon links are affiliate links and I may earn a small commission for any purchases 0:00 Intro 0:36 What is Gunpla? 1:04 What Are Gunpla Grades? 2:41 Tools You Need 4:04 What Comes in a Kit? 4:31 The Manual 5:29 How to Cut a Piece 5:58 Trying the First Step 6:35 The Chest Unit 7:36 The Head 7:45 The Arms 8:30 A Better System / The Legs 10:14 How Long Does it Take? / The Waist 11:24 Weapons & Accessories 12:12 What Else is in the Hobby? 12:32 Panel Lining
